title: Meta AI at Arabic Hate Speech 2022: MultiTask Learning with Self-Correction for Hate Speech Classification
base_benchmarks: Arabic Fine-Grained Hate Speech Detection shared task (Mubarak et al., 2022)
findings: The paper's proposed model, AraHS, which utilizes multitask learning and a self-correction method, outperforms baseline models in detecting fine-grained Arabic hate speech. This includes the capability to identify hate speech directed at the category of 'Religion/Belief', which constitutes 0.30% of the dataset. However, the paper does not provide a specific performance breakdown or detailed analysis for this particular category.
